questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares xylem and phloem tissue?

options.text: Xylem cells are dead and have no end walls; phloem sieve tubes are living and have sieve plates
Xylem cells are living and thin-walled; phloem cells are dead and lignified
Both xylem and phloem cells are dead at maturity
Both xylem and phloem transport water and minerals in the same direction

questions.explanation: Mature xylem vessels are dead, hollow tubes with no end walls, reinforced with lignin. Phloem sieve tube elements are living cells (though with reduced contents) that have perforated sieve plates at their ends to allow the flow of dissolved sugars.
